releaseNotes:
# Changelog

## sdmxsource.net v10.3.0 (2024-12-06)

### Details v10.3.0

1. Bring back support for .NET Standard 2.0 which includes .NET Framework 4.8
1. Improved support for DataSetKey
1. Many changes from the OECD were included in this release
1. SDMX-CSV 2.0.0 improvements
   1. Allow SDMX-CSV 2.0.0 to be returned with SDMX REST 1 as long there are no SDMX 3.0.0 specific features
   1. Support reading SDMX-CSV 2.0.0 with multiple structures
   1. Improved `labels=name` support
   1. Extra validity columns when requesting historic data
1. Improve support for SDMX-JSON 2.0.0 Structure
   1. Data Provider support
   1. Data Constraint support
   1. Improve stub support (reading/writing)
1. SDMX-ML 3.0.0 Do not write DataSet constraint attachment since it is not supported

### Tickets v10.3.0

The following new features added:

- SDMXRI-2508: Retrieve/Store Data/ContentConstraint DataSetKey in SDMXRI (.NET) (DataConstraint,SDMX3.0)
- SDMXRI-2256: IncludeHistory parameter should return extra columns for validFromDate and validToDate values in CSV v2.0 (OECD,PULL_REQUEST)
- SDMXRI-2182: Implement SDMX-CSV 2.0 `labels=name` option (OECD,PULL_REQUEST)
- SDMXRI-2213: Introduce asOf parameter in NSIWS that will return historical data present at the given time (OECD,PULL_REQUEST)
- SDMXRI-2503: SdmxSource .NET DataConstraint SDMX-JSON 2.0.0 reader (DataConstraint,SDMX-JSON-2,SDMX-JSON-2.0.0-Reader,SDMX3.0)
- SDMXRI-2575: Keep support for netstandard2.0
- SDMXRI-2504: SdmxSource .NET DataConstraint SDMX-JSON 2.0.0 writer (DataConstraint,SDMX-JSON-2,SDMX-JSON-2.0.0-Writer,SDMX3.0)
- SDMXRI-2526: SdmxSource .NET DataProviderScheme SDMX-JSON 2.0.0  writer (DataProviderScheme,SDMX-JSON-2,SDMX-JSON-2.0.0-Writer,SDMX3.0)
- SDMXRI-2527: SdmxSource .NET DataProviderScheme SDMX-JSON 2.0.0 reader (DataProviderScheme,SDMX-JSON-2,SDMX-JSON-2.0.0-Reader,SDMX3.0)
- SDMXRI-2223: Update csv 2.0 reader to allow multiple structures in a source file (OECD)

The following bugs have been corrected:

- SDMXRI-2583: SDMXRI minor issues found in v10.2.0-(2024-10-25)
- SDMXRI-2591: MAWEB: NSIWS endpoint configuration to be used with the test client
- SDMXRI-2477: CSV writer 2.0 with labels doesn't write last dimension label if no TIME dimension
- SDMXRI-2402: For metadata retrieval generated SQL should not include dimension content constraint for non-filtered dimension when x-level (currentOnly/upperOnly) parameter is used.
- SDMXRI-2388: Use '~' and '*' only for metadata SQL queries
- SDMXRI-2530: CSV v2 format not returned with REST v1 query
- SDMXRI-2476: SDMXRI minor issues found in v10.0.0-(2024-07-24)

## sdmxsource.net v10.2.0 (2024-10-25)

The following new features added:

- SDMXRI-2399: If-Modified-Since HTTP support in NSI for external caches of structure & data query responses to reduce NSI/SQL work load

The following bugs have been corrected:

- SDMXRI-2307: Fix unnecessary json error 409 Could not find code in codelist (OECD,PULL_REQUEST)
- SDMXRI-2498: Don't sort data above a configured size of data selection (OECD,PULL_REQUEST)
- SDMXRI-2401: Dataflow is returning more data than allowed with the constraints
- SDMXRI-2344: Target .NET 8
